title: Zeus Juice Vermillion Reloaded 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Zeus Juice Vermilion Reloaded Nic Salt e-liquid revitalises the award-winning classic with its irresistible blend of rich, dark red cherries enhanced by the spicy kick of aniseed and wrapped up in a cooling menthol breeze. This deliciously complex combination offers a truly unforgettable vape that ignites your tastebuds with its bold, enigmatic flavours. This e-liquid boasts a 50VG/50PG ratio, striking the ideal balance between rich flavour depth and satisfying cloud production. Formulated with nicotine salts, Vermilion Reloaded ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a perfect choice for both recent ex-smokers and long-time vapers alike. Its compatibility with classic e-cigarette starter kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices enhances its appeal, providing a versatile vaping experience. Produced and bottled in an ISO Class 7 cleanroom, every batch of Zeus Juice Vermilion Reloaded undergoes rigorous testing in a state-of-the-art quality control lab to guarantee the highest standards of safety and quality. Emphasizing environmental responsibility, the bottles and caps are made from recycled plastic, featuring a tamper-evident cap with a drop-down indicator for added security. Experience the intense and soulful blend of sweet cherries, aniseed, and menthol that makes Vermilion Reloaded a must-try flavour for any vaper seeking an electrifying new taste adventure.
